name: search-input
title: Search Input
description: A search field with a leading icon, a clear button, a hint and an error state.

props.name: hint
props.description: Helper text under the field. Hidden while an error is shown.

props.name: error
props.description: Shows the error state and message.

props.name: errorMessage
props.description: Message shown in the error state.

props.name: clearLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the clear button.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the new text on every change.

props.name: onClear
props.description: Called after the clear button empties the field.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the field and hides the clear button.

props.name: containerClassName
props.description: Extra classes for the wrapper around the field.
